verdict.rationale: Google Voice's admin docs say users can link their Voice number to any mobile or landline number and use it from their smartphones, which is the product's own mechanism for reaching a cell. However, the evidence never explicitly describes calls being forwarded or rung through to that linked cell, nor any conditional or scheduled routing for when the team is away. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that inbound calls forward or ring to the linked cell, away/after-hours forwarding rules or schedules, and hands-on confirmation that business-number calls reliably reach the cell.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk

citations.quote: Users can link their number to any mobile or landline number and access Voice on their smartphones and computers.
